 Live CMA Awards 2026 live updates: Ella Langley takes home 1st award of the night; Taylor Swift gets teased about MSG wedding
 Lainey Wilson is hosting the star-studded country music celebration in Nashville. 
 Yahoo News Staff Updated Thu, November 19, 2026 at 1:39 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Taylor Swift arrives at the 60th CMAs. (Jason Kempin via Getty Images) All eyes are on Nashville for country music's biggest night of the year: the 60th CMA Awards . For the third year in a row, country crooner Lainey Wilson is hosting the ceremony, pulling double duty as a performer alongside big names like Ella Langley, Chris Stapleton, Miranda Lambert, Kacey Musgraves, Luke Combs, Tim McGraw and — in her first CMAs performance since 2013 and first appearance at the show since 2016 — Taylor Swift. 
 Airing live on ABC and Disney+, the show is capping what's been a major year for country music, between Langley's record-breaking hit "Choosin' Texas" dominating the airwaves and Swift herself making a long-awaited return to the genre with "I Knew It, I Knew You" from Toy Story 5 . 
 Missed the red carpet? Check out the best and boldest looks here . And read our live blog below to catch all the action unfolding in Music City tonight, from the big winners to the buzziest boot-stomping performances. 
 Live 48 updates Thu, Nov 19, 2026 01:35 AM UTC Kate Murphy Kacey Musgraves and Miranda Lambert perform 'Horses and Divorces'
 Kacey Musgraves and Miranda Lambert performed the duet "Horses and Divorces," which is featured on Musgraves' 2026 album Middle of Nowhere. 
 Kacey Musgraves and Miranda Lambert perform onstage.
 The two had teamed up on the song to clear the air, quashing a years-long feud that started over the 2011 song Mama's Broken Heart." Musgraves cowrote it for herself, but Lambert recorded it as a hit in 2013.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 01:25 AM UTC Kate Murphy Ella Langley says she 'can't believe' she just won Single of the Year
 After winning Single of the Year for her song "Choosin' Texas," Ella Langley thanked her fellow songwriters Luke Dick, Miranda Lambert and Joybeth Taylor, along with producers Lambert and Ben West.
 "I can't believe it's me this is happening to," Langley said as she accepted the award.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 01:19 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Brad Paisley updates classic country songs with Lainey Wilson (and calls out Taylor Swift)
 During host Lainey Wilson's opening monologue, Brad Paisley joined her onstage with an acoustic guitar to sing modernized versions of classic country songs.
 Brad Paisley and Lainey Wilson sing onstage at the CMAs.
 There were several — highlights include "Data Miner's Daughter" (a riff on "Coal Miner's Daughter" by Loretta Lynn, "Way down yonder on the ChatGPT" in honor of Alan Jackson's "Chattahoochee," "Swipe Left or Right" to update "Check Yes or No" by George Strait and "Waiting on a Waymo" instead of "Waiting on a Woman" by Paisley himself.
 "I Never Promised You a Madison Square Garden," Paisley crooned, poking fun at Taylor Swift's wedding venue.
 "That was good," Swift mouthed to the camera, Brittany Mahomes by her side.
 Together, they manifested a Dolly Parton airport, "where every gate is double D."
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 01:16 AM UTC Erin Donnelly Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' wins Single of the Year
 Ella Langley, "Be Her"
 Ella Langley, "Choosin' Texas" — winner 
 Taylor Swift, "I Knew It, I Knew You"
 Lainey Wilson, "Somewhere Over Laredo"
 Cody Johnson, "The Fall"
 Ella Langley and Miranda Lambert.
 (Cindy Ord via Getty Images) Advertisement Advertisement 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 01:10 AM UTC Kate Murphy CMA Awards begin with a heartfelt tribute to Dolly Parton
 Vince Gill and Lainey Wilson perform a tribute to Dolly Parton.
 (Cindy Ord via Getty Images) The 2026 CMA Awards begin with a tribute to country music icon Dolly Parton, who died in August.
 Host Lainey Wilson said, "Our Tennessee angel is with the angels."
 Vince Gill and Wilson sang an emotional duet of "I Will Always Love You," for which Parton was the original singer/songwriter.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:56 AM UTC Neia Balao Little Big Town has arrived
 Hello, Little Big Town! Group members Phillip Sweet, Kimberly Schlapman, Karen Fairchild and Jimi Westbrook posed for photos ahead of tonight's show. Schlapman rocked a red velvet frock with a statement asymmetrical neckline, while Fairchild kept things simple yet chic with a sparkly, fitted gown. Tonight, the quartet is up for Vocal Group of the Year for the 21st consecutive time.
 (From left) Phillip Sweet, Kimberly Schlapman, Karen Fairchild and Jimi Westbrook of Little Big Town.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:52 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Tim McGraw looks dapper in a black cowboy hat
 Tim McGraw is here … is that a hint that Debut: Taylor's Version is coming?
 Tim McGraw at the CMAs.
 (Jason Kempin via Getty Images) Just kidding, folks, I know he's more than the namesake of one of Taylor Swift's first songs — he's a country legend. The "I Like It, I Love It" singer is also performing tonight at the CMAs.
 He's already won an award for Musical Event of the Year for "McArthur," alongside collaborators Hardy, Eric Church and Morgan Wallen.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:50 AM UTC Neia Balao Jessica Chastain is the ultimate blond bombshell 
 Also in attendance for tonight's awards show is none other than Jessica Chastain. The Other Mommy star, who is one of several presenters at the ceremony, was a vision in a lush, deep-red velvet gown. Chastain also rocked her recently unveiled platinum blond bob .
 Jessica Chastain.
 (Kevin Mazur via Getty Images) Advertisement Advertisement 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:48 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Zach Top sports a brown suit ahead of CMAs performance
 Another one of tonight's performers has arrived — this time it's Zach Top, the "I Never Lie" singer who let it slide on the Grand Ole Opry red carpet livestream that he might just be releasing a new song tonight.
 Zach Top arrives at the CMAs.
 He clearly got the memo that men are wearing brown tonight — and thank goodness, he brought his cowboy hat, lest we forget what genre we're celebrating!
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:47 AM UTC Neia Balao Chris Stapleton arrives with wife, Morgane, by his side
 Another CMA Awards, another appearance from the Stapletons. Chris Stapleton is wearing a muted, monochromatic look with a statement cowboy hat, while Morgane Stapleton opted for a gown as red as the carpet.
 Stapleton, who is nominated for four CMAs this year, is primed to have a big night: He's slated for two special performances, one with Mumford & Sons and another with Stephen Wilson Jr.
 Chris Stapleton and Morgane Stapleton.
 (Terry Wyatt via Getty Images) 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:36 AM UTC Neia Balao Kacey Musgraves brings a touch of romance 
 Our dream girl! No one does red carpet glam quite like Kacey Musgraves. The "Dry Spell" hitmaker, who is up for five awards at tonight's show, stepped out in a baby blue suit adorned with embroidered yellow roses and silver rhinestones. Musgraves rocked her signature, lightly tussled dark locks and held a yellow rose as she posed for photos.
 Kacey Musgraves.
 (Jason Kempin via Getty Images) 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:34 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Ella Langley, already a winner, arrives in style
 Ella Langley has arrived, and you'll be seeing these brunette bangs quite frequently tonight. She's got the most nominations of the night with nine, including Entertainer of the Year. Two of her songs, "Choosin' Texas" and "Be Her," are competing with each other for Song of the Year and Single of the Year.
 She's already won Music Video of the Year, and she's performing.
 Ella Langley, the most nominated artist of the night, arrives at the CMAs.
 "Choosin' Texas" is not only the biggest song of the year on the country charts — it's the biggest song of all time in any genre , mathematically speaking. It's hard to overstate what a massive year she's had. And just look at her shine in that cutout gown with red and silver sparkles!
 Advertisement Advertisement 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:33 AM UTC Neia Balao Brown is the color of choice this evening
 It seems a pattern has emerged on the CMA Awards red carpet: The stars are stepping out in brown. Whether it's a monochromatic moment or pops of brown in their ensembles, Luke Bryan, Glen Powell and Luke Combs are among the celebrities who've chosen the earthy hue for tonight's festivities.
 Luke Bryan.
 (Terry Wyatt via Getty Images) 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:30 AM UTC Taryn Ryder Luke Combs makes a case for his competition
 Luke Combs could take home his third CMA Entertainer of the Year trophy Wednesday. But if he's picking someone other than himself, he has a name ready .
 "I mean, it's hard to not vote for Ella [Langley], right?" he told Taste of Country. "I mean, it'd be kind of tough to not vote for her, I would think."
 Langley leads this year's nominations with nine nods , including the top prize. Combs, who won the award in 2021 and 2022, is also competing against Cody Johnson, Chris Stapleton and Lainey Wilson.
 Apparently, the competition has already had an unofficial gathering … at the dentist. Combs said he recently crossed paths with Langley there and believed Wilson had an appointment that same day too.
 "That was pretty wild," he said.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:26 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Brittany Mahomes (and baby No. 4) sparkle in silver
 Congrats are in order for Brittany Mahomes — she looks stunning on the CMAs red carpet. And she just announced baby No. 4 with Kansas City Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes is on the way!
 Brittany Mahomes sparkles in silver on the CMAs red carpet.
 (Jason Kempin via Getty Images) The soccer team owner and former player is a star in her own right, but we can't help but wonder if she's especially stoked to attend the ceremony to see her bestie, Taylor Swift, perform.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:23 AM UTC Neia Balao Carter Faith's orange-and-pink look 
 A baby pink bow? Say less! New Artist of the Year nominee Carter Faith hit the red carpet in an orange strapless gown with ruching along the center of the bodice. Faith added a pop of pink with a statement bow around her waist.
 Carter Faith.
 Advertisement Advertisement 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:22 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Social media stars descend upon the CMAs red carpet 
 These days, social media stars are a staple on pretty much every awards show red carpet. It's OK, I'll tell you who they are.
 First up, we've got Dani Austin, a longtime influencer with an ultra-popular haircare line , in sleek white satin.
 Dani Austin rocks the red carpet at the CMAs.
 (Kevin Mazur via Getty Images) Next there's Madison Humphrey, a comedian known for turning the internet's most embarrassing moments into sketches on TikTok, in a long-sleeved red lace number.
 Madison Humphrey attends the CMAs.
 (Jason Kempin via Getty Images) And then there's Haley Kalil, a model and lifestyle influencer whose slime-green balloon gown from the Kids' Choice Awards is still heavy on my mind, rocking big hair and a plunging off-white gown.
 Haley Kalil dazzles at the CMAs.
 (Terry Wyatt via Getty Images) 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:09 AM UTC Neia Balao Marcus Mumford of Mumford & Sons loves some fringe 
 We see you, Marcus! Ben Lovett, Marcus Mumford and Ted Dwane of the folk-rock band Mumford & Sons were all smiles on the red carpet.
 While the bandmates kept their looks pretty low-key, Mumford added some oomph with a statement fringed black suit jacket. Tonight, Mumford & Sons are performing with Chris Stapleton, marking their first-ever CMA Awards appearance as performers.
 (From left) Ben Lovett, Marcus Mumford and Ted Dwane of Mumford & Sons.
 (Jason Kempin via Getty Images) 
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:05 AM UTC Kelsey Weekman Megan Moroney stuns in princess pink 
 Megan Moroney embraced her classic country Barbie aesthetic once again on the red carpet, this time in a dazzling, nearly-naked pink gown with ethereal tulle sleeves that wrap around her arms.
 Megan Moroney dazzles in pink at the CMAs.
 (Michael Buckner via Getty Images) She's nominated for Female Vocalist of the Year and Best Contemporary Country Album, as well as Song of the Year for "Beautiful Things." She's also among the night's overachievers and will be performing as well.
 Thu, Nov 19, 2026 12:01 AM UTC Neia Balao Luke Combs and wife arrive in coordinating brown looks
 It was date night for Luke Combs and his wife, Nicole, who stepped out in coordinating brown outfits. Combs went for a head-to-toe brown look featuring a textured suit jacket and a fringed pocket square. Nicole, on the other hand, made a statement in a leopard-print frock with a structured, corseted bodice and an asymmetrical skirt.
 Nicole and Luke Combs.
 (Jason Kempin via Getty Images)
